description: Non-Major Safety and Security Events is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. Counts of Non-Major Safety and Security Events are reported to the National Transit Database on a monthly basis, by transit agency and transit mode. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 25 columns, among them Location Group, 5 Digit NTD ID, Agency, Month, Year, Non-Physical Assaults on Operators (Security Events Only). The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
